products.excerpt:
A 15U IT rack is a type of server rack
designed to house and organize information technology (IT) equipment. The
“U” in 15U stands for “rack units,” which is a standard
measurement for the vertical space within a rack. One rack unit is equivalent
to 1.75 inches (44.45 mm) in height.
\n
\nTherefore, a 15U IT rack has a vertical space of 15 x 1.75 inches, which
equals 26.25 inches (666.75 mm) in height. These racks are suitable for
setups with a relatively larger amount of IT equipment and are commonly used
in server rooms, network closets, or data centers.

products.name: 3M UY Connector (100 Pcs)
products.excerpt:
Corning (3M) UY Connector
The small size of corning 3M UY connector reduces the splicing bundle O.D. to a minimum.
The connector’s two ports accept two solid copper conductors. The connector is filled with a sealant to
provide moisture resistance.

The 3M UY Connect(100 Pcs) is a high-quality gel-filled telecom splice connector designed for quick and secure joining of telephone and low-voltage wires. Its insulation displacement technology (IDC) allows easy installation without stripping wires. The gel inside protects connections from moisture, corrosion, and environmental damage, ensuring reliable performance in telecom and networking applications. Ideal for technicians, installers, and telecom professionals.
products.description:
Corning (3M) UY Connector
The small size of corning 3M UY connector reduces the splicing bundle O.D. to a minimum.
The connector’s two ports accept two solid copper conductors. The connector is filled with a sealant to
provide moisture resistance.

The 3M UY gel filled connector pack of 100 is a trusted solution for telecommunication wire splicing and repair. This 100-piece pack of 3M UY gel connectors is designed to create secure, long-lasting connections between two copper conductors without the need to strip insulation.

Using IDC (Insulation Displacement Contact) technology, the connector cuts through the insulation and establishes a strong electrical connection when crimped with a standard crimping tool. The gel-filled interior protects the splice from moisture, dust, and corrosion, making it ideal for both indoor and outdoor telecom installations.

These connectors are widely used in telephone wiring, telecom networks, alarm systems, and low-voltage cable installations. The compact design allows technicians to make quick connections in tight spaces while maintaining reliable signal transmission.

Whether you are a telecom technician, network installer, or maintenance professional, the 3M UY Connector pack of 100 provides a durable and efficient solution for safe and fast wire splicing.

Key Features

  • Original 3M UY Connector

  • Gel-filled design for moisture protection

  • IDC technology – no wire stripping required

  • Suitable for telephone and telecom cables

  • Quick and reliable 2-wire splice connection

  • Compact and easy to install

  • Pack of 100 connectorsv

products.name: 6U Rack Aitek
products.excerpt:
A 6U IT rack is a type of server rack
designed to house and organize information technology (IT) equipment. The
“U” stands for “rack units,” which is a standard
measurement for the vertical space within a rack. One rack unit is equivalent
to 1.75 inches (44.45 mm) in height.
\n
\nTherefore, a 6U IT rack has a vertical space of 6 x 1.75 inches, which
equals 10.5 inches (266.7 mm) in height. These racks are commonly used for
smaller setups or when the amount of equipment is relatively limited.
\n

This PLC Splitter is a 1*32, with 1 input and 32 output fibers with an even split ratio across all fibers regardless of input wavelength. PLC Splitters are availble with 900µm loose tube singlemode fiber and terminated or unterminated as per your needs. Unconnectorized PLC splitters come with no connectors for easy splicing or connectorization.
products.description:
PLC (Planar Lightwave Circuit) Splitters are Single-mode splitters with an even split ratio from one input fiber to multiple output fibers. This PLC Splitter is a 1*32, with 1 input and 32 output fibers with an even split ratio across all fibers regardless of input wavelength. PLC Splitters are availble with 900µm loose tube singlemode fiber and terminated or unterminated as per your needs. Unconnectorized PLC splitters come with no connectors for easy splicing or connectorization.

Product Features

  • High Quality PLC design features a protective metal casing around the fibers
  • PLC splitting mechanism divides input signal into equal parts across all output fibers
  • 900µm loose tube fiber for easy stripping, splicing, or terminating
  • Available pre-terminated with SC/APC Connector

  • Product Specifications

    Wave Length: 1260nm / 1650nm
    Type: 1 * 32
    Insertion Loss (dB) Max: <4.0
    Uniformity (dB) Max: <0.6
    PLD (dB) Max: <0.2
    Directivity Min: 55dB
    Return Loss (dB) Min: 55 (50)
    Operating Temperature: <-40 ~ +85°C
    Power Handling: 300mW

products.name: Ai-Tek Media Convertor 10/100 Single Mode  Simplex 20km 2 RJ45
products.excerpt:
Ai-tek 10 / 100M adaptive Ethernet fiber
optic transceivers, can be 10 / 100Base-TX twisted pair electrical signals
and 100Base-FX optical signal conversion. It extends the network’s
transmission distance from 100 meters to 100 kilometers (single-mode fiber)
from copper. Typical applications are Ethernet distance interconnections,
such as the connection of a cell room to a metro. Because of the adaptive
function, the switch does not require any settings when connected to the
switch. New lightning protection function, to ensure the safety of the
equipment.

products.name: Ai-Tek PLC Splitter SC/UPC/1*16 (Box Type)
products.excerpt: Planar lightwave circuit(PLC) splitter is a type of optical power management device that is fabricated using silica optical waveguide technology. It features small size, high reliability, wide operating wavelength range and good channel to channel uniformity, and is widely used in PON networks to realize optical signal power splitting. Ai-tek provides whole series of 1×N splitter products that are tailored for specific applications. All products meet GR-1209-CORE-2001 and GR-1221-CORE-1999 requirements.
products.description:

products.name: AirFiber5U (AF5U)
products.excerpt: Ubiquiti Networks introduces our proprietary INVICTUS™ core communications processing engine. The speed, power, and efficiency of this integrated circuit enhance the performance of airFiber AF5/AF5U.
products.description:
Features:

Superior Processing 

Ubiquiti Networks introduces our proprietary INVICTUS™ core communications processing engine. The speed, power, and efficiency of this integrated circuit enhance the performance of airFiber AF5/AF5U.

Efficient Use of 5 GHz Band 

airFiber AF5/AF5U features 1 MHz center channel resolution with market-leading Power Envelope Tracking technology. airFiber AF5/AF5U accurately and continuously controls transmit power relative to the band edge. The power level automatically tracks to optimize performance near band edges, allowing you to choose the part of the band with the least interference.

Long-Range Links 

Newly developed for airFiber AF5/AF5U, the patent-pending xRT feature uses an innovative, adaptive multi-channel coding scheme to enhance radio transceiver performance, thereby maximizing your link budget and spectrum utilization – while still maintaining regulatory compliance. This results in links that can span distances from 10 m up to 100+ km.

Quick and Easy Installation

The unique sliding-clamp design of airFiber AF5/AF5U allows mounting hardware to be pre-assembled prior to installation – no more dropped screws at the top of the tower. As an added convenience, the drop-in cradle mount design allows the installer to attach mounting hardware to the pole without having to support the weight of the airFiber radio during installation.

Radio Alignment Display

Introduced on airFiber AF5/AF5U, the Radio Alignment Display (RAD) makes aiming quicker and easier. The dual, calibrated signal strength indicators display the actual signal strength on the local and remote airFiber radios in real-time. The comprehensive array of radio status indicators displays the following:
• GPS synchronization status
• Master/slave mode
• RF link status
• RF overload warning
• Current modulation mode
• Link activity and speed for wired management and data ports

The Huawei eKit Access Point AP362E is a premium wireless access point designed for indoor use, blending the cutting-edge performance of Wi‑Fi 6 with enterprise-grade reliability

  • Dual-band 802.11ax (Wi‑Fi 6) support delivers blazing-fast speeds up to 2.975 Gbps (575 Mbps on 2.4 GHz + 2.4 Gbps on 5 GHz) via 2×2 MU‑MIMO and 160 MHz channel width

  • Equipped with smart adaptive antennas, Beamforming, OFDMA, and advanced modulation (1024‑QAM), it optimizes coverage and minimizes interference—perfect for high-density environments .

Key Specs:

  • Form factor: Sleek circular design, 180 mm diameter × 35 mm height, installs on ceilings or walls.

  • Ports & Power: One Gigabit RJ‑45 port with 802.3af PoE; max power consumption ~9.4

  • User capacity: Supports up to 128 clients (Huawei recommends ~100)

  • Secure management: Cloud-based or standalone control via Huawei eKit App, SNC platform, EasyWeb or local WAC; supports WPA2/WPA3, 802.1X, VLANs, ACLs, DHCP snooping, ARP inspection, IP source guard

  • Advanced WLAN features: DFS, MU‑MIMO, TWT, LDPC, dynamic rate/channel selection, airtime and QoS scheduling .

 

Comparison to Other Popular Models

  • Unlike a Ubiquiti access point or UniFi access point (UAP‑AC‑Pro), the AP362E uses 802.11ax (Wi‑Fi 6), offering up to ~2.9 Gbps vs. ~1.3 Gbps on UAP‑AC‑Pro.

  • The AP362E supports full PoE input; devices like Ubiquiti’s UAP‑AC‑Pro may need PoE+ or adapter.

  • It’s not a portable wifi router, but a fixed wifi access point meant for permanent installation. For mobile, battery-powered usage, you’d choose a different device.

products.excerpt:
The Cisco ® SPS service provider switches deliver cost-effective Metro Ethernet access solutions. These products are optimized for multitenant units (MTUs) and multidwelling units (MDUs) in which the service provider delivers triple-play (VoIP, video, and data) services to multiple businesses or homes in close proximity.
The Cisco SPS2024 24-Port 10/100/1000 Gigabit SP Switch (Figure 1) is ideal for environments in which security and uptime are important. It offers 24 Gigabit copper ports and 2 shared Small Form-Factor Pluggable (SFP) modules for optional optical interfaces for connecting to the core network.
The Cisco SPS switches facilitate the delivery of multiple services over a Layer 2 network with support for Q-in-Q stacking. This feature allows customer VLANs to be kept separate across the service provider backbone. Also, for efficient delivery of multicast traffic (such as video) to multiple customers, these switches provide support for a variation of Multicast VLAN Registration (MVR).
products.description:
The Cisco ® SPS service provider switches deliver cost-effective Metro Ethernet access solutions. These products are optimized for multitenant units (MTUs) and multidwelling units (MDUs) in which the service provider delivers triple-play (VoIP, video, and data) services to multiple businesses or homes in close proximity.
The Cisco SPS2024 24-Port 10/100/1000 Gigabit SP Switch (Figure 1) is ideal for environments in which security and uptime are important. It offers 24 Gigabit copper ports and 2 shared Small Form-Factor Pluggable (SFP) modules for optional optical interfaces for connecting to the core network.
The Cisco SPS switches facilitate the delivery of multiple services over a Layer 2 network with support for Q-in-Q stacking. This feature allows customer VLANs to be kept separate across the service provider backbone. Also, for efficient delivery of multicast traffic (such as video) to multiple customers, these switches provide support for a variation of Multicast VLAN Registration (MVR).
Network security is a primary concern for service providers, and the SPS switches deliver a number of advanced features that alleviate this concern. Support for dynamic Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) inspection eliminates the man-in-the-middle attack. IP Source Guard prevents a subscriber (or malicious user) from using an IP address not assigned to them. DHCP Guard keeps rogue devices from behaving like Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) servers. Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) Root Guard prevents a rogue spanning tree device from advertising that it should be the root bridge, thereby having the spanning tree network compromised by an outside device. Unauthorized access to the network is protected through 802.1X port and multisession authentication and MAC filtering/port security. The 802.1X standard requires clients to authenticate themselves before the port will pass data for them. An additional security feature is access control lists (ACLs), which restrict network use to certain users, groups, or applications. The SPS switches also secure management traffic, with support for Secure Shell (SSH) Protocol, SSL, and Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) v3.
The management capabilities of the SPS switches include support for DHCP option 82, allowing for assignment of IP addresses to subscribers based on where they connect to the network. Management can be performed through a GUI or command-line interface (CLI). The switches also support SNMP for management from a network management station.
Features

• Twenty-four 10/100/1000 switched RJ-45 ports that deliver up to 2000 Mbps of throughput per port

• Two shared mini Gigabit Interface Converter (mini-GBIC) slots for fiber and copper Gigabit Ethernet expansion

• 48-Gbps nonblocking, store-and-forward switching mechanism

• Simplified QoS management enabled by advanced queuing techniques using 802.1p, Differentiated Services (DiffServ), or type of service (ToS) traffic prioritization

• Configuration and monitoring from a console port with the CLI or from a standard web browser with WebView management

• Secure remote management of the switch via SSH and SSL secure channel network protocols

• 802.1Q-based VLANs, enabling segmentation of networks for improved performance and security

• Stacking Q-in-Q VLANs, allowing customer VLANs to transparently cross a service provider network and isolate traffic among customers

• Private VLAN Edge (PVE) for simplified network isolation of guest connections or autonomous networks

• Automatic configuration of VLANs across multiple switches through Generic VLAN Registration Protocol (GVRP) and Generic Attribute Registration Protocol (GARP)

• Automatic medium dependent interface (MDI) and MDI crossover (MDI-X) detection

products.description:
Huawei eKit AP361 – High-Speed Indoor WiFi 6 Access Point

The Huawei eKit AP361 (also called eKitEngine AP361) is a high-performance indoor WiFi access point built for modern enterprise and SME networks. It supports the 802.11ax (WiFi 6) standard, offering improvements in throughput, efficiency, capacity, and client management over prior generations.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Dual-band 2.4 GHz & 5 GHz (2×2 MIMO): Simultaneous support for both bands ensures compatibility and load balancing for legacy and newer devices.
  • Up to 1.775 Gbps throughput: When combining both bands, the AP can reach a device rate as high as 1.775 Gbps.
  • WPA3 security: The device supports the newest wireless security standard for safer encryption and protection.
  • PoE support & Gigabit uplink: The Ethernet port negotiates 10/100/1000 Mbps and supports Power over Ethernet, simplifying installation without separate power cabling.
  • Compact and flexible installation: Lightweight (≈0.45 kg) with options for ceiling, wall, or T-rail mounting.
  • Scalable user capacity: It supports multiple concurrent users (up to 128 access users recommended

Use Cases & Ideal Environments

  • SME offices & co-working spaces
  • Educational institutes / classrooms / auditoriums
  • Hotels, restaurants, retail outlets
  • Indoor campus and public spaces where strong reliable connectivity is needed

By deploying multiple AP361 units, you can build a managed WiFi 6 network with good coverage, load balancing, and seamless client experience.

Why Choose AP361?

Many access points in the market advertise “WiFi 6” and “high throughput,” but AP361 strikes a balance of affordability, reliability, and features. With full support for WPA3, PoE, and dual-band MIMO, it competes well vs alternatives in the same tier.

Optimize your indoor network with Huawei’s eKit series and deliver faster, more stable WiFi experience to users.

products.description:
Here’s a more detailed, long-form description of the Huawei eKit Gateway S380-L4P1T:

The Huawei eKitEngine S380‑L4P1T Multi‑Service Gateway is a compact, fanless device designed for small to medium-sized businesses, delivering secure routing, switching, and management in one sleek package. Featuring 1 × Gigabit WAN uplink and 4 × Gigabit LAN ports with 802.3at PoE+ delivering up to 50 W total, it can power IP cameras, phones, or access points without external adapters

Under the hood, it offers an 8 Gbps switching capacity, packet forwarding rates of ~300 Kpps (up) and ~420 Kpps (down), and 1 Gbps egress bandwidth, supporting up to 150–200 users and managing up to 32 Huawei eKit APs . A quad-core 800 MHz CPU, 512 MB DDR4 RAM, and 512 MB NAND storage provide responsive performance .

Security is robust, including firewall/NAT, IPSec/PPTP/L2TP/SSL VPN, URL filtering, anti-ARP spoofing, ACLs, and SSH/SSL management . QoS, traffic shaping, and user management allow fine-tuned bandwidth control for critical applications

With no fans, its metal chassis ensures near-silent operation (<30 dB) and low energy use (~7 W typical; ~61 W max including PoE) . Its rugged build (0–40 °C, 5–95% humidity, IP20, MTBF ~76 years) and 0.8 U rack/desktop form factor make it reliable in varied environments.

Management is flexible—accessible via web GUI, CLI, SNMP, RMON, and supports cloud-based oversight for centralized configurations and monitoring. For networks utilizing Huawei eKit APs, the gateway doubles as a local controller, simplifying deployment and eliminating the need for separate WLAN controllers.

Ideal for: SOHO offices, hotels, schools, factories, security installations.

Key highlights:

  • Fanless, silent, energy-efficient design
  • Built-in PoE+ on 4 ports
  • Full-featured security & VPN
  • Capacity to serve up to 200 users and 32 APs
  • Robust, easy-to-manage all-in-one gateway

products.description:

The Huawei eKitEngine S380‑S8P2T is a high-performance, all-in-one multi-service gateway tailored for small to medium-sized enterprise networks. Designed with a focus on simplicity, scalability, and silent operation, it integrates routing, switching, security, and wireless access control in one compact fanless chassis.

This model comes equipped with 10 Gigabit Ethernet ports—8 LAN ports with PoE+ (802.3at) and 2 uplink WAN/LAN combo ports—delivering a total PoE power budget of 124 W. It eliminates the need for external power adapters by powering access points, IP cameras, and VoIP phones directly from the gateway.

Powered by a quad-core processor and 1 GB of DDR4 memory, the S380‑S8P2T delivers up to 2 Gbps uplink throughput and 8 Gbps switching capacity. It supports 300–400 concurrent users and can centrally manage up to 64 Huawei eKit wireless access points, making it a suitable choice for campuses, retail stores, offices, and hospitality environments.

On the security side, it offers a comprehensive suite of features, including firewall, NAT, VPN (IPSec, SSL, PPTP, L2TP), URL filtering, anti-ARP spoofing, and ACLs. These protections help ensure secure and stable access for internal and remote users alike.

Management is intuitive and flexible, supporting web GUI, CLI, SNMP, and cloud-based control. It enables remote configuration, monitoring, and updates—perfect for IT administrators overseeing distributed networks.

Built with a durable metal fanless design, it operates silently with a typical power draw of just 12 W (excluding PoE load). It’s compact enough for desktop placement or rack-mounting, suitable for a wide range of deployment scenarios.

Key Features:

  • 8 × Gigabit LAN PoE+ ports (124 W total), 2 × WAN/LAN combo ports
  • Up to 300–400 user support, 64 AP centralized control
  • Full L3 routing, firewall, VPN, ACLs, QoS
  • Fanless, silent, energy-efficient, metal casing
  • Suitable for small offices, retail, education, and hospitality

products.excerpt: Huawei eKit L2+ Switch S310S-8P4JX is a compact, fanless business switch for SMBs, offering reliable connectivity, easy management, and smart office networking.
products.description:
Huawei eKit Switch S310S-8P4JX – High-Performance, Quiet, and Reliable Networking for SMBs

The Huawei eKit Switch S310S-8P4JX is a professional-grade, Layer 2+ managed switch designed to meet the growing networking needs of small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), educational institutions, retail outlets, and branch offices. Part of Huawei eKit switch series, which focuses on simple, smart, and secure network solutions, this switch offers advanced functionality, energy-efficient design, and effortless deployment, making it an ideal choice for reliable business connectivity.

With 8 Gigabit Ethernet PoE+ ports, the switch is capable of powering devices such as IP cameras, wireless access points, and VoIP phones—eliminating the need for separate power supplies and reducing cabling costs. In addition, 2× 10GE SFP+ and 2× 2.5GE SFP ports provide high-speed uplinks for faster data transmission, smooth network expansion, and seamless connection to core switches or servers.

The S310S-8P4JX supports a wide range of Layer 2+ features, including VLAN, QoS, ACL, static routing, and IGMP snooping, giving network administrators precise control over traffic, security, and bandwidth allocation. Its fanless, natural cooling design ensures silent operation, making it perfect for noise-sensitive environments like offices, schools, or retail shops.

Built with energy efficiency in mind, the switch supports Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE), which reduces power consumption during low network usage. The compact and durable design ensures easy installation on desktops or inside cabinets, and its cloud and web-based management options make setup and monitoring simple, even for non-technical users.

Key Benefits:

  • Optimized for SMBs: Combines performance, simplicity, and security to meet modern business networking demands.

  • PoE+ Support: Provides up to 128W of total PoE power, ideal for powering multiple IP devices directly from the switch.

  • Advanced L2+ Features: Enables VLAN segmentation, network security, bandwidth management, and static routing for enhanced control.

  • Quiet Fanless Design: Ensures silent, maintenance-free operation—ideal for quiet indoor environments.

  • Flexible Uplinks: High-speed uplink ports support smooth connection to core networks or other switches.

  • Easy Deployment & Management: Intuitive web interface and optional cloud management via Huawei eKit switch platform simplify setup and operation.

Huawei eKitEngine AP772 Outdoor Wi-Fi 7 Access Point

The Huawei eKitEngine AP772 delivers ultra-fast outdoor wireless connectivity powered by the latest Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) technology.   • Dual-band 2.4GHz & 5GHz radios
  • 2×2 + 4×4 MIMO (6 spatial streams)

These technologies provide higher network efficiency, improved spectrum utilization, and lower latency for enterprise applications.

Built for Outdoor Deployments

products.description:
The IMOU 128GB Class 10 MicroSDXC Card (ST2‑128‑S1) is engineered to meet the demanding needs of modern CCTV and smart camera systems. products.name: IMOU K1S-W WiFi Smart Door Lock (K1S-G-W-EN)
products.excerpt: The IMOU K1S-W WiFi Smart Door Lock offers secure keyless entry with fingerprint, PIN code, RFID card, mobile app control, and mechanical key backup. Featuring built-in WiFi connectivity, remote access via the IMOU Life app, long battery life, and multi-user support, it provides smart and reliable access control for homes and offices.
products.description:
The IMOU K1S‑W Wi‑Fi Smart Door Lock (model K1S‑G‑W‑EN) is a versatile and secure smart lock designed to elevate home and office entry control. Equipped with built‑in Wi‑Fi (2.4 GHz), it connects seamlessly to the IMOU Life app for remote access, user management, and notifications. The lock supports a broad range of unlocking methods, including biometric fingerprint recognition, PIN code, RFID card (M1), mobile app control, and mechanical key emergency access, ensuring flexibility for all users. It can store up to 100 fingerprints, 10 RFID cards, and 10 PIN codes, and also supports temporary passwords for guests or service providers. Power is supplied by 4 × AA batteries, offering up to approximately 12 months of typical use, and the lock includes a USB‑C emergency power input and a low battery warning. Compatible with doors approximately 35 – 100 mm thick, the K1S‑W operates reliably from ‑10 °C to +55 °C.

IMOU K1S‑W Wi‑Fi Smart Door Lock

Key Features

Multiple Unlocking Methods – Biometric fingerprint, PIN code, RFID card, IMOU Life app control, and mechanical key support.

Wi‑Fi Connectivity & Remote Access – Built‑in Wi‑Fi (2.4 GHz) enables remote lock/unlock and management via the IMOU Life app.

High Credential Capacity – Stores up to 100 fingerprints, 10 RFID cards, and 10 PIN codes, including support for temporary guest codes.

Backup & Emergency Power – Powered by 4 × “AA” batteries with low battery warning and a USB‑C emergency power supply port.

Temporary Password Support – Create one‑time or limited‑use PIN codes for guests.

Wide Door Compatibility – Designed to fit doors with thickness between ~35 mm and 100 mm.

Durable & Reliable Operation – Works in temperatures from ‑10 °C to +55 °C.

Real‑Time Notifications & Access Logs – View access history and receive alerts via the IMOU Life app.

The IMOU Titan Pro is a powerful outdoor PTZ security camera created for continuous protection of residential and commercial properties. Equipped with a 6MP high-resolution sensor delivering 3K+ clarity, it captures fine details, realistic textures and accurate colors, ensuring reliable visual evidence in both daytime and nighttime conditions.


Advanced Night Imaging and Optical Performance

At the heart of Titan Pro is Aurora Color Night Vision technology. The ultra-wide F1.0 aperture lens allows significantly more light to reach the sensor, while the large imaging surface preserves subtle details in dark scenes. Supported by IMOU AI-ISP multi-layer processing, the camera delivers bright, full-color night footage with minimal noise and improved contrast, closely matching daytime visibility even in poorly lit environments.


Stable Connectivity and Flexible Installation

Titan Pro supports dual-band Wi-Fi 6 on 2.4GHz and 5GHz frequencies for fast, stable and interference-resistant wireless communication. For professional setups, PoE connectivity enables both power and data transmission over a single cable, simplifying installation and improving system reliability. Adaptive network optimization ensures smooth live viewing and responsive remote control at all times.


AI-Powered Detection and PTZ Coverage

Powered by AIgo Play intelligence, IMOU Titan Pro accurately identifies humans and vehicles while supporting intrusion detection, line crossing alerts, loitering detection, occlusion monitoring and people counting. Automatic target tracking keeps moving objects in focus as the camera rotates up to 340° horizontally and 90° vertically. Custom patrol routes and scheduled cruise modes allow full-area monitoring without manual control.


Smart Recording and Active Deterrence

The AOR Mode intelligently switches between continuous low-frame recording and full-frame event capture, reducing storage consumption by up to 80 percent while retaining every important moment. Built-in sirens, customizable alarm tones and flashing red and blue warning lights provide effective active deterrence, discouraging intruders before incidents escalate.


Two-Way Audio, Privacy Control and Storage Options

Two-way audio enables real-time communication through the camera with low latency and clear sound quality. Users can configure privacy schedules and protected zones to match daily routines. Video can be stored locally on a microSD card, integrated into NVR systems or secured via Imou Protect cloud services, offering flexible storage solutions for different security needs.

products.description:
Microlink Eco Series UTP Cat6 Patch Cord 5 Meter Blue

The Microlink Eco Series UTP Cat6 Patch Cord (5 Meter, Blue) is designed to deliver fast, reliable, and stable network connectivity for both home and office environments. Whether you’re setting up a new network or upgrading an existing one, this high-quality patch cord ensures smooth and uninterrupted data transfer, making it ideal for high-speed internet, file sharing, video streaming, VoIP, and other bandwidth-intensive applications.

With a length of 5 meters, this Cat6 patch cord provides flexibility in cable management, allowing you to connect devices over moderate distances without the need for additional extension cables. The blue color adds visual clarity and simplifies cable identification, especially in structured cabling systems or multi-device setups.

The cable is made with Category 6 (Cat6) unshielded twisted pair (UTP) wiring, which supports data transmission speeds of up to 1 Gigabit per second (Gbps) and handles bandwidths up to 250 MHz. This ensures stable performance even in environments with multiple connected devices and heavy network traffic.

Constructed using 100% pure bare copper conductors, the cable offers excellent signal integrity and minimal interference. The 24 AWG stranded copper wire adds flexibility without compromising performance, making it easy to route the cable through tight spaces or cable trays. Each end of the patch cord is equipped with RJ45 connectors featuring gold-plated contacts, which resist corrosion and provide a secure, long-lasting connection.

As part of the Eco Series, this patch cord is manufactured using environmentally responsible materials and is RoHS compliant, meaning it is free from hazardous substances. This makes it a smart choice for those looking to build a greener, more sustainable network infrastructure.

Whether you’re connecting computers, servers, printers, network switches, or routers, the Microlink Eco Series UTP Cat6 Patch Cord is a dependable solution for modern networking needs. Combining quality, durability, and environmental responsibility, this 5-meter cable is a practical investment for any data setup.

products.description:
The MikroTik RB1100Dx4 (RB1100AHx4 Dude Edition) is a powerful enterprise-grade rackmount router designed for ISP backbones, enterprise networks, and data center environments requiring high reliability and performance.

It is powered by a quad-core ARM AL21400 CPU running at 1.4GHz, delivering strong routing performance with support for advanced networking tasks such as firewalling, VPN, MPLS, and traffic management.

The device includes 13 Gigabit Ethernet ports, allowing flexible network segmentation and high-density wired connectivity for enterprise deployments.

A key highlight of the Dude Edition is its 60GB pre-installed M.2 SSD storage, designed for running The Dude monitoring system, caching, logging, and other storage-intensive network applications.

It supports dual redundant power inputs (AC + DC / PoE input options depending on setup), ensuring maximum uptime in mission-critical environments where power failure is not acceptable.

With RouterOS Level 6 license, it provides full enterprise features including advanced routing protocols, VLANs, BGP/OSPF support, firewall rules, and secure IPsec hardware acceleration for encrypted traffic.

Its 1U rackmount metal chassis makes it suitable for professional installation in server racks, ISPs, and enterprise network cabinets.

products.name: MikroTik RB260GSP (CSS106-1G-4P-1S) 5-Port Gigabit PoE Smart Switch
products.excerpt:
• 5 × Gigabit Ethernet Ports
  • 1 × Gigabit SFP Fiber Port
  • 4 × Passive PoE Out Ports
  • SwOS Smart Switch Management
  • Passive PoE In Support (11–30V)
  • Ideal for SOHO & CCTV Networks
products.description:
The MikroTik RB260GSP (CSS106-1G-4P-1S) is a compact and reliable 5-port Gigabit smart switch designed for small office, home, and CCTV network deployments. It offers simple switching performance with passive PoE support for powering compatible network devices.

This switch includes 5 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 1 SFP fiber port, allowing flexible copper and fiber connectivity in a single compact device.

Ports 2–5 support passive PoE output, enabling the switch to power devices such as IP cameras, wireless access points, and other MikroTik-compatible hardware using the same input voltage.

The device runs MikroTik SwOS (Switch Operating System), providing a lightweight web-based interface for VLAN configuration, port control, traffic monitoring, and basic Layer 2 management features.

Powered via passive PoE-in or DC jack (11–30V), the RB260GSP is designed for efficient low-power operation while still delivering stable Gigabit switching performance.

Its compact design and SFP uplink make it ideal for CCTV systems, small ISP setups, and network extensions where simplicity and reliability are required.

products.excerpt:
Ubiquiti AF-5XHD airFiber-5XHD 5GHz 1.3Gbps+, 200+KM Carrier Backhaul Radio

Ubiquiti’s airFiber 5XHD PTP LTU is equipped with custom silicon and its proprietary radio architecture is designed specifically for long‑distance, outdoor wireless applications.

The Core communications processing engine surpasses all of the limitations inherent to generic Wi‑Fi chips to provide superior performance, long‑range capability, DFS flexibility, higher constellations, and power output, along with better receive sensitivity.

The AF‑5XHD features industry‑leading 10.6 bps/Hz spectral efficiency, line-rate data packet processing for up to 1.3 Gbps of real data throughput, and innovative xtreme Range Technology (xRT™) for up to 100 km in range.

Product Features

• Programmable Transmit Power: The radio’s transmit power level can be programmed up to +29 dBm.

• Programmable Duty Cycle: (GPS synchronized frames) The AF-5XHD allows configuration of asymmetric TX and RX duty cycles. TX ratios include 25%, 33%, 50%, 66.7%, and 75%.

• Configurable GPS Synchronization: The AF-5XHD offers configurable support for 2, 2.5, 4, and 5 ms frames. Timing is compatible with all other synchronous systems.

• Split TX and RX Frequency: The radio can operate on different frequencies for TX and RX, allowing great flexibility for interference avoidance.

• Split TX and RX Channel Bandwidth: Support for different channel bandwidths for TX and RX allows users to scale required data capacity more efficiently

• Adaptive Modulation up to 1024QAM: Adaptive modulation rates of up to 1024QAM (4096QAM with targeted upgrade) are supported.

• Dual Redundant Gigabit Ethernet Ports with PoE: The AF-5XHD has two Gigabit Ethernet ports that can be used to provide redundant PoE power.

• OFDM and OFDMA Support: The radio offers flexible scheduling for 2, 4, or 8 sub channels.

• Bluetooth Wireless Configuration: Use the built-in Bluetooth interface for wireless configuration.

• Align Lock™ Antenna Aiming Guard This alerts the user when the radio or antenna aiming is changed due to tampering, impact, or storm damage.

• User-Configurable Interference Mitigation Three user-selectable profiles support both high interference and greenfield deployments for robust, optimal performance.

• Redundant Images for Fail-Safe Configuration Creation of backup firmware images ensures fail-safe configuration and enhances reliability.

• Persistent Spectrum Analysis with Dedicated RX Perform real-time spectral analysis for the full band on live links without interrupting the link operation.

• Wide Voltage Range, Enhanced Surge Protection The AF-5XHD has an operating voltage range of 24 48VDC and provides enhanced surge protection.

Combine multiple airFiber X radios on a single dish antenna for superior noise immunity performance, redundancy, and multi-Gigabit Point-to-Point (PtP) throughput.

Multi-Gigabit Throughput
Introducing the airFiber NxN, a thoughtfully engineered MIMO multiplexer that increases the amazing throughput of your airFiber link by up to 400%, while simultaneously establishing redundancy without the need of additional antennas.

The airFiber NxN is a scalable MIMO multiplexer that combines multiple airFiber 5X radios on a single dish antenna for superior noise immunity performance, redundancy, and multi-Gigabit throughput. Upgrading a 5 GHz airMAX or airFiber link is fast and easy. Simply attach the airFiber NxN to the fast-mount on the antenna and connect the RF cables.

products.description:

The Ubiquiti airMAX LiteBeam M5 LBE-M5-23 is a lightweight, high-performance 5GHz outdoor wireless bridge designed for Point-to-Point (PtP) and Point-to-Multipoint (PtMP) deployments. Featuring a 23dBi directional antenna, airMAX technology, and long-range connectivity exceeding 30 km, it is an ideal solution for WISP networks, enterprise backhaul, CCTV connectivity, and outdoor broadband deployments.

The Ubiquiti airMAX LiteBeam M5 LBE-M5-23 is a cost-effective outdoor wireless broadband CPE engineered for professional Point-to-Point (PtP) and Point-to-Multipoint (PtMP) wireless applications. Built on the proven airMAX® M platform, it combines a 23dBi high-gain directional antenna with an integrated radio to provide exceptional wireless performance, interference immunity, and long-distance connectivity.

Operating in the license-free 5GHz frequency band, the LiteBeam M5 is ideal for extending networks across buildings, campuses, industrial parks, warehouses, factories, farms, surveillance systems, and ISP last-mile deployments. Its innovative lightweight design minimizes wind load while maintaining excellent signal stability and installation flexibility.

With support for Passive PoE, low power consumption, and weather-resistant construction, the LiteBeam M5 offers dependable operation in harsh outdoor environments while delivering a reliable wireless bridge capable of connecting locations over 30 kilometers apart.

Whether you’re building a WISP infrastructure, connecting remote offices, extending surveillance networks, or deploying enterprise wireless backhaul, the LiteBeam M5 provides outstanding performance at an affordable price.

products.name: Ubiquiti NSM5 NanoStation M5
products.excerpt: Reliable outdoor Wi-Fi solution, the Ubiquiti NSM5 NanoStation M5 offers long-range 5GHz wireless connectivity for point-to-point or multipoint networks.
products.description:
Ubiquiti NSM5 NanoStation M5

The Ubiquiti NanoStation M5, also known as the Ubiquiti NSM5, is a high-performance outdoor wireless device designed for long-range connectivity over the 5 GHz frequency band. Built for reliability and durability, this device is ideal for creating point-to-point (PtP) or point-to-multipoint (PtMP) wireless links, often used in environments where running physical cables is not practical or cost-effective.

At its core, the NSM5 features a powerful integrated dual-polarity directional antenna with a gain of around 14 to 16 dBi. This allows it to deliver strong signal strength and maintain stable connections even over distances of up to 15 kilometers, assuming clear line of sight. It uses 802.11a/n Wi-Fi standards and 2×2 MIMO technology to enhance throughput and connection reliability. In real-world conditions, users can expect data transfer rates of over 150 Mbps, which makes it suitable for applications like video surveillance backhaul, rural internet distribution, or building-to-building networking.

The NanoStation M5 runs on Ubiquiti’s proprietary airOS firmware and supports airMAX technology. These systems are designed to improve wireless performance by reducing latency, increasing bandwidth efficiency, and handling multiple users more effectively through TDMA (Time Division Multiple Access) protocols.

Physically, the NSM5 is compact, lightweight, and rugged. It’s enclosed in a weather-resistant casing that’s built to withstand harsh outdoor conditions, with an operational temperature range that makes it suitable for deployment in both hot and cold climates. The device is powered using Passive Power over Ethernet (PoE), which means it only requires a single Ethernet cable for both power and data—making installations simpler and more flexible.

Another useful feature is its secondary Ethernet port, which allows for PoE pass-through. This can be used to power another nearby device, such as a security camera, without needing an additional power source.

Overall, the Ubiquiti NanoStation M5 is a dependable, cost-effective solution for wireless networking professionals who need long-distance, high-speed outdoor connectivity. Whether you’re linking remote buildings, extending internet access in rural areas, or setting up a surveillance system, the NSM5 delivers robust performance with a relatively easy setup.

Build and expand your network with Ubiquiti Networks UniFi Switch 16 XG, part of the UniFi Enterprise System. The US-16-XG is a fully managed, 16-port, 10G fiber switch that enhances network capacity by providing high-bandwidth aggregation connectivity to multiple switches in your network. The US-16-XG offers an extensive suite of advanced Layer-2 switching features and protocols. It offers the forwarding capacity to simultaneously process traffic on all ports at line rate without any packet loss. The total non-blocking throughput is up to 160 Gbps. It features 12 SFP+ ports for fiber connectivity. For Copper connectivity, it offers four RJ45 ports that support 10GBASE-T, that standard for 10 Gbps connections using CAT6 (or higher) cabling and RJ45 connectors.

• (12) 1G/10G SFP+ Ports
• (4) 1G/10G RJ45 Ports
• (1) RJ45 Serial Console Port

• Switching Capacity: 320 Gbps

• Rack Mountable with Mount Brackets (included)

products.name: Ubiquiti UniFi AP-AC-HD
products.excerpt:
Ubiquiti UAP-AC-HD UniFi 802.11ac High-Density Indoor/Outdoor 2.4/5GHz AP
Deploy Ubiquiti UniFi AC HD AP in high-density environments requiring maximum wireless performance. The UniFi AC HD AP features simultaneous dual-band, 4×4 MU-MIMO technology, and convenient 802.3at PoE+ compatibility. The Wave 2 MU-MIMO technology allows the AP to communicate with multiple clients at the same time – significantly increasing multi-user throughput and overall user experience. The UniFi AC HD AP is the first UniFi 802.11ac Wave 2 AP. It combines the performance increases from MU-MIMO technology and the use of 4×4 spatial streams to deliver up to 125% greater performance than a typical Wave 1 AP.

At any single time, a Wave 2 AP can communicate with the following MU-MIMO clients:
• Four 1×1 clients
• Two 2×2 clients
• One 2×2 clients and two 1×1 clients
• One 3×3 clients and one 1×1 client

Product Features:
• Radio Hardware Acceleration: Independent 2.4GHz and 5GHz dedicated hardware offload for maximized multi-user throughput and reduced latency
• CPU Hardware Acceleration: Dedicated hardware offload for QoS, Guest Control, and Client Management
• Optimized for MU-MIMO: Genetically optimized antenna arrays for maximal utilization of 802.11ac Wave 2 MU-MIMO Beam Forming
• Beam Forming: Data is sent and received using multiple antennas to increase throughput and range

products.excerpt: The Ubiquiti UniFi AP-XG Access Point is a high-performance enterprise wireless solution built for high-density networks. The Ubiquiti UniFi AP-XG features 802.11ac Wave 2 technology with 4×4 MU-MIMO, delivering ultra-fast speeds and supporting up to 1,500 connected clients. products.description:
The Ubiquiti UniFi AP-XG is a high-performance enterprise wireless solution designed for high-density environments that demand ultra-fast connectivity. The Ubiquiti UniFi AP-XG Access Point supports 802.11ac Wave 2 technology with advanced MU-MIMO (Multi-User, Multiple Input, Multiple Output), allowing the access point to communicate with multiple clients simultaneously. This capability significantly increases multi-user throughput and improves the overall user experience.

The UniFi AP-XG WiFi Access Point provides 28 autonomous (non-overlapping) channels, including three channels in the 2.4 GHz band and 25 channels in the 5 GHz band, along with DFS channels for enhanced wireless performance. Equipped with 4×4 spatial streams, the device can support more than triple the number of users per radio compared to a standard Wave 1 access point.

Designed for enterprise-level deployments, the Ubiquiti AP-XG Enterprise Access Point helps expand your 10-Gigabit network infrastructure as part of the UniFi Enterprise Wi-Fi System. It delivers exceptional speed, reliability, and scalability for large offices, campuses, and high-traffic wireless environments. Businesses looking for the best UniFi AP-XG Price and performance will find this access point ideal for demanding network applications.

  • 10 Gigabit Ethernet Support

  • 4×4 MU-MIMO Quad-Radio: (3) Client Radios, 1 Security Radio

  • Dual 5 GHz 802.11ac Wave 2 Radios

  • 3.466 Gbps Combined Radio Rate in 5 GHz

products.name: UISP Switch Pro
products.excerpt:
Powerful 24-port Gigabit PoE switch with 4 SFP+ uplinks, 220W PoE, touchscreen, and UISP management for reliable, high-speed networks.High-performance Layer-2 PoE switch with 24 Gigabit ports, 4 SFP+ uplinks, 220W PoE budget, and UISP management for pro network deployments.

The Ubiquiti UISP Switch Pro is a high-performance, fully managed Layer-2 PoE switch designed to deliver powerful connectivity for professional and service provider networks. Equipped with 24 Gigabit RJ-45 ports, including 16 ports supporting 27 V passive PoE, it efficiently powers multiple devices such as access points, CPEs, and IP cameras. The switch also features 4 SFP+ 10 Gbps ports for lightning-fast fiber uplinks, ensuring seamless data transfer and network scalability.

With a switching capacity of 128 Gbps and a forwarding rate of up to 95 Mpps, the UISP Switch Pro ensures reliable, low-latency performance in demanding environments. It offers a 220 W PoE budget and supports up to 30 W per port, providing flexible power distribution for various network devices.

Built for convenience and durability, the compact 1U rack-mount design includes a 1.3-inch color touchscreen for easy monitoring. Dual power inputs (AC and 27 V DC) ensure redundant operation, minimizing downtime. Managed through the UISP platform, it delivers centralized control, VLAN management, and advanced Layer-2 features. The UISP Switch Pro is the ideal solution for ISPs, enterprise networks, and edge deployments that demand reliability, scalability, and intelligent management.
products.description:
220W (27V) PoE switch with (24) GbE
RJ45 ports, including (16) with 27V passive PoE, and (4) 10G SFP+ ports.

The Ubiquiti UISP Switch Pro is a high-performance, fully managed Layer-2 PoE switch designed for demanding network environments. With 24 Gigabit RJ-45 ports—including 16 supporting 27 V passive PoE—and 4 SFP+ 10 Gb ports for high-speed uplinks, it delivers a switching capacity of 128 Gbps and a forwarding rate around 95 Mpps. With a robust 220 W PoE budget (up to 30 W per port), a 1.3″ colour touchscreen, and dual AC/DC power redundancy, this rack-mount 1U unit offers both power and flexibility. Ideal for ISPs, edge networks and large-scale deployments, it also integrates seamlessly with the UISP platform for centralized management. Reliable, scalable and versatile—the UISP Switch Pro brings enterprise-grade switching and PoE in a streamlined package.

The Ubiquiti UISP Switch Pro is a powerful and intelligent Layer-2 managed PoE switch built to deliver superior performance, flexibility, and reliability for professional network environments. Designed to meet the needs of ISPs, enterprise networks, and service providers, this switch offers 24 Gigabit RJ-45 ports, including 16 ports with 27 V passive PoE output, enabling efficient power delivery to multiple devices such as access points, radios, and cameras. In addition, it features 4 SFP+ 10 Gbps fiber ports that ensure ultra-fast uplinks and seamless network scalability.

With a switching capacity of 128 Gbps and a forwarding rate of approximately 95 Mpps, the UISP Switch Pro delivers smooth, non-blocking data throughput even in high-demand environments. It supports a total PoE budget of 220 W, offering up to 30 W per port, which makes it perfect for powering high-performance devices.

Engineered in a compact 1U rack-mount design, it includes a 1.3-inch color touchscreen for quick monitoring and management. Dual power options (AC mains and 27 V DC input) provide redundant power for maximum uptime and stability.

Managed through the UISP platform, the switch offers advanced Layer-2 features such as VLAN support, port isolation, traffic shaping, and detailed device management. Combining silent, fanless operation with enterprise-grade reliability, the Ubiquiti UISP Switch Pro is the ideal solution for scalable, high-performance networks.

products.name: Unifi E7 AP

The UniFi E7 AP is a premium enterprise WiFi 7 access point engineered for ultra-high-density environments.
It delivers unmatched reliability, performance, and security across modern corporate, campus, and enterprise networks.
products.description:
The UniFi E7 AP represents the future of enterprise wireless connectivity under the UniFi Enterprise series by Ubiquiti UniFi. Designed for organizations that demand uninterrupted, high-capacity WiFi, it features 10-stream WiFi 7 technology, a 10 GbE uplink, and a redundant GbE port to ensure maximum throughput and network resilience. Supporting over 1,000 client devices within 185 m² (2,000 ft²), the E7 AP excels in large offices, campuses, and mission-critical enterprise environments.

With advanced features such as real-time spectral analysis, seamless fast roaming (802.11r/k/v), and intelligent radio resource management, the UniFi E7 AP optimizes performance for every connected device. Secure authentication through Passpoint, vouchers, and RADIUS over TLS ensures enterprise-level protection, while centralized management through the UniFi Enterprise Controller allows IT administrators to monitor and scale deployments effortlessly. Available exclusively through Microtech Pakistan, the official UniFi Enterprise distributor, this device redefines how enterprises experience next-generation connectivity.

products.name: UniFi E7 Audience AP

The UniFi E7 Audience AP is an enterprise-grade WiFi 7 access point engineered for large-scale, high-density environments.
It delivers unmatched speed, scalability, and stability with 12-stream 5 GHz and 6 GHz performance under the UniFi Enterprise series.
products.description:
The UniFi E7 Audience AP is a flagship model within the UniFi Enterprise lineup, purpose-built for ultra-dense environments such as stadiums, arenas, and large public venues. With 12-stream tri-band WiFi 7 performance across 5 GHz and 6 GHz bands, it ensures seamless connectivity for over 1,500 client devices simultaneously. This enterprise-grade access point features a 10 GbE uplink, redundant GbE port, and IP68-rated enclosure, offering exceptional durability and performance in both indoor and outdoor deployments.

Equipped with advanced features such as zero-wait DFS, intelligent radio management, and 802.11r/k/v fast roaming, the E7 Audience AP guarantees uninterrupted wireless experiences even in high-demand scenarios. Managed via the UniFi Enterprise Controller, this access point combines power, intelligence, and scalability — available exclusively through Microtech Pakistan, the official Ubiquiti UniFi Enterprise distributor.

products.name: UniFi Enterprise  Access Retrofit Reader
products.excerpt: UniFi Enterprise UA-Retrofit-Reader is a premium, high-security enterprise access control reader engineered to upgrade legacy door entry points with modern NFC, mobile app credentials, and centralized UniFi Access intelligence.
products.description:
The UniFi Enterprise UA-Retrofit-Reader is a high-performance smart credential reader designed specifically for corporate offices, educational facilities, and secure industrial campuses looking to modernize their physical security infrastructure. Built for smooth transitions, it upgrades legacy access hardware without replacing existing wiring.

This premium entry device features advanced high-frequency NFC technology and secure encrypted communication protocols to prevent card cloning or unauthorized interception. The UniFi Enterprise UA-Retrofit-Reader allows employees and authorized personnel to unlock doors seamlessly using enterprise smart cards, key fobs, or official mobile smartphone credentials.

Engineered with a weather-resistant, durable enclosure, the reader operates reliably across both indoor entryways and exposed outdoor building perimeters. It features an elegant visual indicator interface, providing clear, instant LED feedback regarding access authorization, entry denials, and system communication status.

The compact, low-profile design ensures it mounts cleanly over standard single-gang electrical boxes or existing reader cutouts. This architecture minimizes installation labor, speeds up system deployment times, and maintains a clean aesthetic across premium building entrances.

Fully integrated into the centralized UniFi Access ecosystem, the UniFi Enterprise UA-Retrofit-Reader offers real-time log tracking, customizable access schedules, and immediate credential provisioning. It provides security administrators with a scalable, modern, and highly dependable entrance management solution.

products.name: Unifi Enterprise Access Retrofit Hub 2
products.excerpt: Unifi Enterprise UA-Retrofit-Hub-2 is an enterprise-grade multi-door access control mechanism engineered to transition legacy wiring infrastructures into a secure, centralized, and cloud-managed UniFi Access ecosystem.
products.description:
The Unifi Enterprise UA-Retrofit-Hub-2 is a premium centralized security controller designed specifically for corporate offices, commercial centers, and industrial facilities upgrading to modern physical security systems. Built to optimize infrastructure investments, it utilizes existing legacy multi-conductor wiring configurations flawlessly.

This advanced smart controller features dual-door terminal management inputs, allowing security integrators to connect, power, and monitor two independent doors from a single unit. The Unifi Enterprise UA-Retrofit-Hub-2 effortlessly interfaces with existing magnetic locks, electronic strikes, exit buttons, and emergency alarms.

Engineered with comprehensive overcurrent safety layers and intelligent electrical isolation, the hub prevents damage caused by voltage spikes or lock feedback loops. It provides stable Power over Ethernet (PoE++) input distribution, running complex combinations of locks, readers, and auxiliary accessories easily.

The compact, rack-mountable or enclosure-ready chassis streamlines cable management, keeping internal network closets clean, organized, and properly cooled. products.name: Unifi U7 Pro Max
products.excerpt: The U7 Pro Max delivers ultra-fast tri-band WiFi 7 performance, ideal for high-density environments needing reliable, high-speed wireless connectivity.
products.description:
Unifi U7 Pro Max

The Ubiquiti Unifi U7 Pro Max is a ceiling or wall‑mount, tri‑band WiFi 7 (IEEE 802.11be) access point designed for high‑performance and high‑density network environments. It merges cutting‑edge wireless technology with robust hardware to deliver fast, reliable connectivity across the 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands. Whether for enterprise offices, event spaces, large homes, or co‑working environments, it aims to support many simultaneous devices without performance bottlenecks.

Key Features & Capabilities

  • Tri‑band WiFi 7 Support
    The U7 Pro Max supports WiFi 7, which is the next generation of WiFi beyond WiFi 6/6E. It provides enhancements like wider channel widths (for example up to 320 MHz in the 6 GHz band), improved spectral efficiency, and better modulation schemes.

  • Spatial Streams & MIMO
    It offers 8 spatial streams in total:
    • 2.4 GHz: 2×2 MU‑MIMO
    • 5 GHz: 4×4 MU‑MIMO
    • 6 GHz: 2×2 MU‑MIMO

  • High Throughput Rates
    The device is capable of very high data rates when properly configured:
    • Around 688 Mbps on 2.4 GHz (with ~40 MHz channel) 
    • Up to ~8.6 Gbps on the 5 GHz band
    • Around ~5.7 Gbps on the 6 GHz band

  • Coverage & Device Capacity
    One U7 Pro Max unit is marketed to cover about 160 square meters (≈ 1,750 square feet) and manage 500+ connected devices with simultaneous performance.

  • Hardware & Build
    Mechanically, it has a diameter of about 206 mm and height ~46 mm; weighs roughly 680 grams. The housing is a mix of polycarbonate and aluminum, with mounting brackets included for ceiling or wall installation.

  • Antenna Gain & Transmit Power
    • Gains: ~4 dBi on 2.4 GHz, ~6 dBi on 5 GHz, ~5.9 dBi on 6 GHz bands.
    • Maximum transmit power cited: about 23 dBm on 2.4 GHz and 6 GHz, and up to 29 dBm on 5 GHz.

  • Power & Uplink
    It is powered via PoE+ (Power over Ethernet) with a supported voltage range of about 44‑57 V DC, drawing around 22‑25 watts. Uplink to the network is through a single RJ‑45 port that supports 2.5 GbE, which helps ensure that high wireless throughput isn’t artificially limited by a slow uplink.

  • Software & Management
    The U7 Pro Max integrates with Ubiquiti’s UniFi Network software (versions 8.2.93 and later) and benefits from features like real‑time spectral scanning (to dynamically assess wireless spectrum usage and avoid interference), advanced QoS, guest traffic isolation, VLAN support, etc.

  • Environmental Tolerances
    The device is rated for indoor use, with operating temperature from about ‑30 °C to +50‑60 °C depending on source, and humidity tolerance of 5‑95% non‑condensing.

Use Cases & Advantages

Here are scenarios where the U7 Pro Max shines:

  • Environments with many users (conference rooms, auditoriums, coworking spaces) where many devices connect concurrently, needing high throughput and minimal latency.

  • Businesses that want to future‑proof their wireless infrastructure, by investing in WiFi 7, so upcoming devices that support wider channels and newer standards perform well.

  • Dense indoor spaces with potential for interference — the spectral scanning engine can help optimize channel selection.

  • Places where powerful wireless performance over 5 GHz is particularly important (for gaming, video streaming, large file transfers).

products.name: ZKTeco AS32-DOOR MAGNET SENSOR
products.excerpt: The ZKTeco AS32-DOOR MAGNET SENSOR is a wired magnetic door contact switch designed to detect door open/close status reliably for access control and security systems. Compatible with ZKTeco access control panels, alarms, and monitoring systems, it provides stable normally‑closed contact output and seamless performance suitable for offices, commercial facilities, residential buildings, and institutional entrance control in Pakistan.
products.description:
The ZKTeco AS32-DOOR MAGNET SENSOR by ZKTeco is a high‑reliability magnetic contact switch used in access control and security installations to monitor the status of doors (open or closed). It operates using a magnet and sensor arrangement — when the magnetic field is aligned (door closed), the internal reed switch remains in a closed circuit; when the magnet separates from the sensor (door opened), the switch changes state, triggering a signal to the control panel.

This sensor is designed to work with ZKTeco access control systems and alarm panels, offering a durable and cost‑effective solution for improving door status detection and security. Its normally closed (NC) output ensures constant monitoring and reliable reporting, while the compact wired design provides straightforward installation on door frames and bodies. Ideal for businesses, educational institutions, hospitality facilities, and residential developments, the AS32 sensor enhances security automation and system responsiveness in everyday use.

Key Features

General Performance

  • Manufactured by ZKTeco for integration with access control and security systems.

  • Designed for wired door status detection to confirm door open/close state.

  • Normally Closed (NC) contact output ensures reliable monitoring and signaling.

Electrical & Functional Specifications

  • Operating voltage rating up to 100 VDC (typical for contact output systems).

  • Load current capacity up to 500 mA, suitable for standard security panel inputs.

  • Operating distance approximately 16 mm ± 5 mm between sensor and magnet for reliable contact triggering.

Design & Installation

  • Consists of a magnet and sensor pair — installed on the door frame and door leaf respectively to detect status changes.

  • Compact and lightweight construction allowing easy surface mounting.

  • Suitable for use with biometric access control panels, alarm systems, and monitoring devices where door position input is required.

Usage & Environment

  • Ideal for security and automated access installations in offices, commercial buildings, schools, hospitals, and residences in Pakistan.

  • When connected to a control panel, the sensor enhances system awareness of unauthorized entries or unauthorized door openings.

products.name: ZKTeco CM‑280S Electromagnetic Lock

products.description:
The ZKTeco CM‑280S Electromagnetic Lock is engineered as a secure door locking solution for access control installations where a fail‑safe magnetic lock is required. Utilizing electromagnetism, the CM‑280S generates a powerful holding force that keeps doors firmly secured while power is applied. When the power is cut (such as during authorized access or an emergency), the lock instantly releases, ensuring safety compliance and convenient egress.

This overhead electromagnetic lock features surface mounting for easy installation on a wide range of door types including metal, wood, glass, and fire‑rated doors, using appropriate brackets if needed. Its rugged anodized aluminum body ensures long‑lasting performance even in high‑traffic environments. Integrated LED indicators help installers and users quickly assess lock status, while compatibility with standard access control systems makes the CM‑280S ideal for advanced security setups across commercial and institutional locations in Pakistan.

Key Features

Locking Performance

  • Holding force approx. 280 kg (600 lbs) for strong and secure door retention.

  • Fail‑safe operation: lock remains engaged when powered and releases when power is cut.

Electrical & Power

  • Dual‑voltage support (12 V or 24 V DC) provides installation flexibility and compatibility with different power supplies.

  • Current draw: ~420 mA at 12 V DC and ~210 mA at 24 V DC, optimizing energy use.

Build & Design

  • Durable anodized aluminum housing for long‑term use and resistance to daily wear.

  • Surface mounted installation with included mounting plate; optional brackets available for inward/outward or glass door setups.

  • LED status indicators (two‑color) for lock condition (locked/unlocked).

Compatibility & Integration

  • Works with access control systems, including biometric terminals, card readers, and exit sensors.

  • Compatible with standard control panel connections (12 V and GND interface).

  • Dimensions: approx. 250 × 48.5 × 27 mm (body) — compact but robust.
